title: cheilanthes aurantia
intro: Cheilanthes aurantia, commonly known as the orange spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes aurantia include wound healing, immune system support, and the relief of symptoms associated with respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
